subject.statement: Sam Bankman-Fried is still serving his 25-year sentence.

summary: Sam Bankman-Fried was sentenced to 25 years in federal prison in March 2024. As of July 2026, there have been no credible reports of sentence reduction, pardon, or release, so he is still serving that sentence.
